canonical_claim.template: In 2025, Luminate Bank denied {value} of its 1,729 decisioned FHA applications.

required_qualifiers.population: Luminate Bank decisioned FHA applications (actions 1,2,3; loan_type 2; reverse mortgages excluded)
required_qualifiers.nature: historical institutional aggregate, unadjusted for applicant mix

does_not_establish: Luminate Bank will deny any specific future application with 8.2% probability
Luminate Bank is stricter or more lenient than another lender for a given applicant
Luminate Bank discriminates or violates law
8.2% applies to Luminate Bank's non-FHA lending
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.

proposed_use.proposed_sentence: This lender will likely reject YOUR application
